reports.title: PHINIA REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS, IMPROVES FULL YEAR OUTLOOK

guidance.heading: FINANCIAL GUIDANCE
section: The following forward-looking guidance reflects PHINIA’S current expectations and beliefs as of October 29, 2026, and is subject to change. The following statements apply only as of the date of this disclosure and are expressly qualified in their entirety by the cautionary statements included elsewhere in this document.

Full-Year 2025 Actual | Prior Full-Year 2026 Guidance | Revised Full-Year 2026 Guidance1
Net sales | $3,483 million | $3,565 to $3,665 million | $3,625 to $3,675 million
Net earnings | $130 million | $155 to $180 million | $160 to $182 million
Adjusted EBITDA | $478 million | $485 to $515 million | $500 to $520 million
Adjusted EBITDA margin | 13.7% | 13.5% to 14.1% | 13.7% to 14.1%
Adjusted free cash flow | $212 million | $210 to $250 million | $220 to $250 million
Adjusted tax rate | 32.5% | 30% to 33% | 28% to 30%
